d:
The Greek Freak battled against one of the toughest teams in the tournament, attacking the basket, grabbing rebounds and bringing his trademark intensity on every possession!
Despite Team USA's defensive pressure, Giannis finished with an impressive 15 points and 13 rebounds. But Kemba Walker and the Americans proved too much, securing a 69-53 victory over Greece.
Giannis never backed down and gave everything he had for his country!
Relive the BEST moments from his battle against Team USA!
